frozen_search_identity.selection_rule: first passing fixture in P0..P3 then ascending frozen supply order

B01.interpretation: Preserves the E3H-A positive-control fixture exactly.

B12.interpretation: The A1 second-node -1 cm scope collision is removed by the frozen drier-profile search without changing event physics or tolerances.

O13.interpretation: The A1 second-node -1 cm scope collision is removed by the frozen drier-profile search without changing event physics or tolerances.

O14.supply_grid_sensitivity: weak; changing 1.5..12 KSAT does not remove the lower-bound pathology
O14.local_balance_observation: At representative lower-bound trials q01 exceeds qtop, so the fixed h0=0 top-cell event would require storage gain while the local flux difference drives storage loss; the optimizer therefore collapses tau toward zero.
O14.important_nonconclusion: This does not prove that an isolated O14 top-node h=0 event root is physically impossible. For P0 the maximum allowed surface-face flux within the 0..1 cm surface-head scope exceeds the representative q01, so root existence remains an open topology/solver question.

global_interpretation: The finite initial-profile search resolves the prior B12 and O13 fixture-scope failures and preserves B01 as an unchanged positive control.
O14 fails all 24 frozen cases at the event-time lower bound and becomes worse as the frozen profile is made drier.
Therefore extending the profile grid, lowering the tau floor, or changing the supply grid is not justified by A2 evidence.
The next step must be reference-only O14 root-existence/event-topology diagnosis before any Ross candidate or qualification policy changes.
hard_guards: Do not lower the 1e-8 day event-time floor based on this result.
Do not extend or tune the A2 profile/supply grids after observing O14.
Do not treat the O14 fixture failure as a Ross-physics falsification.
Do not alter the already qualified B01/B12/O13 fixtures in A3.
A3 is diagnostic/reference-only and may not qualify a production candidate.
